how_adapted: Used as the CommonMark parser and base HTML renderer. Patched in place to add GFM pipe tables (table block type, delimiter-row block start, row/cell nodes with alignment and \| unescaping, inline parsing of cells) and GFM ~~strikethrough~~ (tilde delimiters producing del nodes). src/markdown.js subclasses HtmlRenderer to escape raw HTML, sanitise javascript:/vbscript:/file:/data: URLs to '#', add heading ids and render tables/del; slugify/toc/CLI are original glue code.
